C1472.title: 2024 Survey of V2X Air-Interface Communication Security
C1472.summary: A 2024 survey from the Science and Technology Branch of the China Confidentiality Association reviewed the DSRC and C-V2X technology paths and analyzed threats to air-interface communication between vehicles and roadside units. It covered signal interception, data tampering, unauthorized access, identity spoofing, man-in-the-middle attacks, and wireless interference, and summarized mitigations including encryption, device authentication, intrusion detection, and prevention.
